description: Counts a project's tests by state (active, skip, fixme, todo, expectedToFail, notLoaded) and by tag and annotation, from the test files, without running them. Use it first, for questions such as how many tests are skipped, or which files or tags have the most skipped tests; use find_tests to list the tests themselves. states, tags and grep count only the tests they match. groupBy "file", "tag" or "project" adds the counts of each, sorted by name and paged with limit and cursor; a test with no tag is in no tag group, and one whose projects the scan cannot tell in no project group. configs lists the config files read and their projects. Example: {"states": ["skip", "fixme"], "groupBy": "file"}.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous answer, for the next page. Keep the other arguments the same.

directory.description: A folder inside the project to scan, relative to its root, such as "packages/web". Default: the root.

expandCases.description: Lists each case of a .each or .for table and each pass of a loop as its own test, with the name the runner gives it and caseIndex, as the runner registers them. Ids differ from those without it, so pass the same value to get_tests. Default: false, one test per declaration with caseCount.

framework.description: The test runner. Default: the one the server was started with, otherwise the one the project in `directory` uses.

grep.description: Keeps tests whose fullName (describe titles and title joined with " > ") matches this regular expression, ignoring case.

groupBy.description: Adds the counts of each file, tag or project.

patterns.description: Globs of the test files, relative to `directory`, such as ["tests/**/*.spec.ts"]. Default: the ones the server was started with, or without them the files the configs in `directory` and below it run.

related.description: Changed files, relative to the project root as `git diff --name-only` writes them, such as ["pages/order-ticket.ts"]. Keeps the tests a change to one of them can affect: those whose dependencies include it, and those that reach code the scan can't follow (hasUnfollowedDependencies).

states.description: Keeps tests in one of these states.

tags.description: Keeps tests with one of these tags, written as in the titles, such as "@smoke".

name: test_summary

ConfigRecord.description: A runner's config that scanned files use. For Playwright and Vitest, the outermost config at or above the file that runs it, up to the root, else the nearest; for Jest, the one at the root and the projects it names; for the other runners, the one config they read for the whole run. Read as code, never run.

extends.description: Files the config takes settings from through imports, such as a shared base config, in the order read.

projects.description: The projects the config runs tests in: Playwright's `projects`, or one for a config without them; Vitest's, with each browser instance as one; Cypress's testing types, `e2e` and `component`; one for the other runners. Null when the scan can't work them out.

relativeFilePath.description: Path from the project root, with `/` separators.

dependencies.description: Playwright's projects that run before this one; `[]` for Vitest.

name.description: As the runner names it: `''` for a project without a name.

testDir.description: The folder the project's test files are found in, from the project root: Playwright's `testDir`, Vitest's `dir`, Jest's `rootDir`, Jasmine's `spec_dir`, Bun's `[test] root`; for the other runners, the config's folder.

Summary.description: Counts over the whole scan. Each test count uses the same definition as the matching test key.

configs.description: The config files the scanned test files use, with their projects; [] when none was found.

anyOf.description: One page of groups; null without groupBy.
What to do next, when there is something to say.
Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

scanErrors.description: Problems of level error in the scan, which may leave tests out of the answer.

summary.description: Counts over the matching tests; fileCount is every file scanned.

anyOf.description: All groups, on every page; null without groupBy.
